<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="20" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
    <line x1="326" y1="16" x2="326" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <rect x="337" y="13" width="3" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="342" y="11" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="347" y="9" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="361" y1="14" x2="366" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="372" y="8" width="17" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="374" y="10" width="12" height="8" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
    <rect x="389" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="28,63 20,71 28,79" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="21" y1="71" x2="39" y2="71" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="61" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Trip planning</text>
    <text x="195" y="82" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Personalize your lessons</text>
    <line x1="16" y1="95" x2="374" y2="95" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="111" width="342" height="10" rx="64" fill="#E5E5E5"/>
    <rect x="24" y="111" width="85.5" height="10" rx="64" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <text x="24" y="143" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">STEP 1 OF 4</text>
    <text x="366" y="143" text-anchor="end" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">25%</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Main heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="184" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="26" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Where are you going?</text>
    <text x="24" y="213" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">We’ll help you practice the words</text>
    <text x="24" y="236" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#4B4B4C">you’re most likely to use on your trip.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Language card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="25" y="261" width="340" height="100" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="24" y="259" width="340" height="100" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="40" y="275" width="71" height="54" rx="11" fill="#FF4B4B"/>
    <rect x="63.5" y="275" width="24" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="40" y="290" width="71" height="24" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="128" y="288" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">LEARNING LANGUAGE</text>
    <text x="128" y="316" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="21" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">French</text>
    <polyline points="337,302 344,309 337,316" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="128" y="340" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Great choice for your adventure</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Destination field -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="398" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Your destination</text>
    <rect x="24" y="411" width="342" height="57" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="438" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="54" y1="444" x2="60" y2="450" stroke="#15451F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="72" y="445" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">City or country</text>
    <text x="24" y="492" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">For example: Paris, France</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Suggested destinations -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="535" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Popular destinations</text>

    <rect x="24" y="551" width="104" height="78" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="24" y="549" width="104" height="78" rx="13" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="576" r="12" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
    <polygon points="45,583 52,569 59,583" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <circle cx="55" cy="573" r="3" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="72" y="579" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Paris</text>
    <text x="40" y="610" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">France</text>

    <rect x="143" y="551" width="104" height="78" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="143" y="549" width="104" height="78" rx="13" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="170" cy="576" r="12" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
    <polygon points="164,583 171,569 178,583" fill="#00A47D"/>
    <circle cx="174" cy="573" r="3" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="191" y="579" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Montréal</text>
    <text x="159" y="610" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">Canada</text>

    <rect x="262" y="551" width="104" height="78" rx="13" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="262" y="549" width="104" height="78" rx="13" fill="#F8FCFF" stroke="#D1EBF7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="289" cy="576" r="12" fill="#D1EBF7"/>
    <polygon points="283,583 290,569 297,583" fill="#6195D3"/>
    <circle cx="293" cy="573" r="3" fill="#FFC800"/>
    <text x="310" y="579" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#15451F">Nice</text>
    <text x="278" y="610" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#6F6F70">France</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Reassurance callout -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="650" width="342" height="50" rx="13" fill="#DDF4FF"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="675" r="12" fill="#1899D6"/>
    <text x="48" y="680" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
    <text x="70" y="671" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#15451F">You can change this anytime</text>
    <text x="70" y="690" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#456B64">We’ll tailor phrases to your trip.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Continue button disabled -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="714" width="342" height="48" rx="13" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <text x="195" y="744" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Continue</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="774" width="390" height="70" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="16" y1="774" x2="374" y2="774" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="43,792 53,784 63,792 63,804 55,804 55,797 51,797 51,804 43,804" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="53" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="139" cy="793" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="139" y1="787" x2="139" y2="799" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="133" y1="793" x2="145" y2="793" stroke="#6F6F70" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="139" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Practice</text>

      <polyline points="230,793 234,797 241,789" fill="none" stroke="#00A47D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="235" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#00A47D">Plan</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="333" cy="789" r="5" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <ellipse cx="333" cy="802" rx="11" ry="6" fill="#6F6F70"/>
      <text x="333" y="822" text-anchor="middle" font-family="DIN 2014 Rounded VF, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#6F6F70">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
